title: Talent Intake and Role Certification Protocol
author: Evelyn Park
body:
Overview

Purpose: This document defines a standardized, measurable protocol for (1) intake and requisition approval, (2) structured interview loops and scorecards, (3) manager-led onboarding checkpoints, and (4) a formal 30/60/90 role certification process. The protocol is intended to reduce time-to-productivity, improve hiring quality, and create repeatable remediation paths when new hires fall short of expected outcomes.

Scope
- Applies to all full-time and long-term contractor roles at Redwood Inference.
- Does not replace role-specific technical training plans maintained by teams; it standardizes vendor-agnostic hiring and certification mechanics.

Objectives
- Decrease time-to-offer to <= 30 calendar days for priority hires.
- Ensure >= 90% of hires complete role certification or an agreed remediation plan within 90 days.
- Provide clear manager and recruiter responsibilities for each stage.

Key Definitions
- Role Certification: Formal sign-off (Pass, Conditional Pass, or Fail) at or before day 90 that the hire meets the documented role outcomes.
- Intake Packet: A single artifact submitted by hiring manager to initiate hiring (role brief, success outcomes, interview rubric, compensation band).
- Certification Evidence: Work samples, code reviews, customer feedback, and manager observations used by the certification panel.

Roles & Responsibilities
- Hiring Manager: Drives intake packet, owns interview loop design, assigns a 90-day sponsor, and leads certification decision.
- Recruiter: Manages sourcing, candidate experience, scheduling, time-to-hire metrics, and offers.
- Interviewers: Use the canonical scorecard, document notes in the ATS, and score candidates objectively.
- 90-Day Sponsor: A peer (not the direct manager) who assists with ramp plan and provides independent feedback for certification.
- People Ops: Approves intake paperwork, maintains calibration artifacts, runs hiring metrics reviews quarterly.

Intake and Requisition Approval (Procedure)
1) Hiring manager completes the Intake Packet template in the ATS and attaches role definition + top 6 success outcomes.
2) Run a 15-minute intake sync with Recruiter to confirm search strategy and target slate.
3) People Ops reviews compensation alignment and headcount budget. Approval SLAs: People Ops to respond within 3 business days; urgent exceptions marked with "expedite" flag.
4) Recruiter creates requisition and posts to approved channels.

Interview Loop Design (Guidelines)
- Standard loop composition (recommended): 1x screen (30m), 2x functional interviews (45m each), 1x cross-functional culture/partner interview (45m), 1x final bar-raiser or manager interview (30-45m).
- Scorecards: Use the canonical scorecard below. Interviewers must add a short rationale for any score less than 3.

Canonical Scorecard (example row for engineer roles):
| Dimension                 | 1 (Low)                         | 3 (Meets)                            | 5 (Exceeds)                        |
|--------------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Core Technical Skill     | Unable to reason about tradeoffs  | Solid design and debugging skills    | Creatively optimizes across stacks |
| Problem Solving          | Fails to decompose                | Structured decomposition & execution | Anticipates edge cases & tradeoffs |
| System Design / Scale    | No architecture awareness         | Sufficient for product requirements  | Designs for failure & capacity     |
| Collaboration & Impact   | Weak communication, siloed       | Cross-team contributor               | Inspires and mentors others        |
| Role-specific Outcome    | Misses baseline expectations      | Completes expected outcomes          | Delivers beyond 6-month outcomes   |

Scoring and Hiring Recommendation
- Aggregate numeric score and write a 2–3 sentence recommendation: Hire / Hire with Conditions / Do Not Hire.
- Bar-raiser principle: a designated bar-raiser must explicitly agree for "Hire" in roles that affect core platform reliability or security.

Offer & Acceptance
- Offer approvals: Manager + People Ops + Finance must sign off on compensation within the band.
- Typical cadence: verbal offer same day as approval; formal offer within 48 hours.
- New hire forms, I-9/contract, and benefits enrollment instructions are sent via HRIS on acceptance.

Pre-Day-1 Checklist (Manager & Recruiter)
- Manager: Provide the new hire with role brief, 30/60/90 outcomes, documentation links, and the 90-day sponsor name.
- Recruiter: Confirm equipment, calendar invites (orientation + 1:1s), and intro to the buddy.

Onboarding Milestones and Manager Checkpoints
- Day 1: Orientation (HR), team intro, setup access, assign buddy. Manager checklist: kickoff 1:1, run through immediate priorities.
- Week 1: Deliver first task with a clear acceptance criteria.
- Day 30: Formal check-in; capture 30-day feedback in the HRIS.
- Day 60: Technical checkpoint and cross-team integration feedback.
- Day 90: Role Certification meeting (see below).

Role Certification Process (30/60/90 Formalization)
Purpose: Produce an objective decision on whether the hire is fully performing to the documented role outcomes.
Protocol:
1) Certification Window: Complete by day 90 unless an approved extension is requested before day 60.
2) Evidence Package (submitted by manager at day 80):
   - 30/60/90 self-assessment by hire (1 page).
   - Manager observations and completed milestones (bullet list).
   - Two work artifacts: PRs, designs, or customer deliverables with link and brief context.
   - Sponsor feedback (written).
3) Panel Composition: Manager (owner), 90-day sponsor, one cross-functional peer, and an impartial People Ops reviewer. For technical roles, add a technical bar-raiser where applicable.
4) Decision Matrix (unambiguous):
   - Pass: Meets >= 80% of role outcomes and has at most one minor gap with a 30-day remediation plan.
   - Conditional Pass: Meets 60–79% of outcomes or multiple minor gaps; requires a documented 30–90 day remediation and weekly check-ins.
   - Fail: < 60% of outcomes or one major gap (security, data integrity, or safety related); triggers the People Ops remediation/offboarding workflow.
5) Outcomes are recorded in HRIS and a follow-up plan is created in Asana/Jira.

Remediation & Support
- Conditional Pass Plans must include measurable milestones, weekly sponsor check-ins, and a clear owner.
- If remediation fails, People Ops will present offboarding options with at least two business days notice and a final transition plan.

Manager Playbook (Quick Checklist)
- Before hire: complete Intake Packet, assign sponsor, confirm ramp tasks.
- Week 0: Setup accounts, issue first task, introduce team norms.
- Week 2–4: Provide actionable feedback twice; ensure candidate has small wins.
- Day 45: Calibration touchpoint with hiring manager peer to surface early risks.
- Day 90: Run certification meeting, document outcome and next steps.

Calibration & Quality Controls
- Quarterly hiring calibration: People Ops convenes hiring managers and bar-raisers to review a sample of recent scorecards and certification outcomes to detect bias, drift in expectations, and rubric gaps.
- Metric dashboard (people-ops-owned): time-to-hire, offer-to-accept rate, 90-day certification pass rate, manager satisfaction score. Target KPIs: time-to-hire <= 30 days, offer-to-accept >= 60%, 90-day certification pass >= 90%.

Templates & Example Snippets
- Intake Packet Subject Line: "Intake: Senior Backend Engineer (Infra) — Q4 Hire"
- Candidate Decline Email (short):
  "Hi <Name>,

  Thank you for interviewing with Redwood. After careful consideration we will not move forward with your application for the Senior Backend Engineer role. We enjoyed learning about your experience and will keep your profile for future roles.

  Best,
  <Recruiter name>"

- Certification Notification (Pass):
  "Hi <Name>,

  Congratulations — based on your 90-day review and the evidence provided, you have successfully completed role certification for <Role>. We appreciate your contribution and look forward to your continued impact.

  Next steps: 1) Updated goals in performance system; 2) Schedule 6-month growth planning.

  Best,
  <Manager>"

Data & Audit Requirements
- All interview scorecards and certification decisions must be stored in the ATS and HRIS for a minimum of 3 years to support audits and calibration.
- People Ops will keep an anonymized sample of scorecards for bias analysis per quarter.

Exceptions and Escalation
- If a hiring manager requests to waive the Intake Packet or canonical loop for speed, the request must be emailed to People Ops with justification and signed off by a Director-level stakeholder.
- Certification disputes (hire vs. fail) escalate to People Ops and the hiring manager’s director; a second independent review will be scheduled within 7 business days.

Frequently Asked Questions (short)
- Q: Can certification be extended beyond 90 days?
  A: Yes, but the extension must be requested and approved before day 60 with a clear rationale and new deadline.
- Q: Who provides the remediation coach?
  A: The 90-day sponsor usually provides coaching; People Ops can assign a learning partner for specific technical remediation.

Appendix: Quick intake template fields
- Role title
- Team & manager
- Level and IC/Manager designation
- Top 6 success outcomes (bulleted)
- Must-have vs nice-to-have skills
- Compensation band
- Target hire date
- Interview loop and proposed interviewer slate
